meaning: 频繁地从一个地方搬到另一个地方
usageNote: 这是个短语描述，日常口语超常见！形容那种'搬家狂魔'的生活方式，带点漂泊感～

examples.en: My job requires me to frequently move from one place to another, so I never feel truly settled.
examples.zh: 我的工作要求我频繁地四处搬迁，所以我从未真正安定下来。

examples.en: Children who frequently move from one place to another may find it hard to maintain friendships.
examples.zh: 经常四处搬家的孩子可能很难维持友谊。
